item.title: Eng’s in Kingston to receive James Beard award
item.description: Eng’s Chinese Restaurant has spent nearly a century feeding Kingston. This week, it got a national stamp of approval. item.title: Highland housing developments on track to add hundreds of units
item.description: Highland is making strides toward addressing its critical lack of housing. The hamlet’s development pipeline currently boasts multiple projects totaling over 200 potential units. If they all move forward as planned, it will amount to a roughly 8% increase in total housing supply.
